g.aria-label: Let the open space stay open.
The space between the modules is part of the mark. Preserve it with the same care as the blocks.
X = the width of one module
Choose Ink, Paper, Ion, or a true one-color reproduction.
Scale the entire asset. Keep all eight modules together.
Leave at least one module of clear space on every side.
Use the micro version at 16px. Use the master from 24px.
Use supplied outlined lockups; do not retype the logo.
Avoid stretching, gradients, outlines, and multicolor modules.
